scene_description: A bright, narrow galley kitchen viewed toward a rear doorway, with a teal stove and small cabinet on the left, a long counter and multicolored drawers on the right, upper cabinets, and a potted plant by the door.
initial_target_observations: The initial right countertop is nearly plain white, with only a few faint, thin diagonal marks. The reference has broad, softly varying gray marble-like streaks across the surface.
candidate_target_observations: The candidate right countertop has more visible, long pale gray streaks running along its depth, closer to the reference's veined surface. The streaks remain subtle and more regular than the reference's varied, stronger marbling.
geometric_plausibility_observations: The candidate preserves the galley layout, with the stove in the left foreground and the long right counter receding toward the plant and doorway. Compared with the reference, the view is more centered and distant, the stove is cropped differently, and the doorway appears as a mostly white leaf beside a narrow gray opening rather than a dark opening with a thin oblique leaf edge. Cabinet and appliance forms are simplified; RGB alone cannot confirm physical contact or hidden geometry.
new_visible_defects: No clear new geometric defect is visible. The countertop streaks look somewhat uniform and faint compared with the reference marble.
other_changes: The candidate and initial images otherwise appear very similar in composition, objects, pale materials, and soft lighting. Both lack much of the reference's floor wood grain, contrast, appliance detailing and strong sunlight patch; the reference has a darker, more textured stove and more pronounced material variation.

evidence.description: The right countertop shows broad, irregular gray-white marble-like streaks.
The right countertop is mostly flat white with sparse faint line marks.
The right countertop has more continuous pale streaking, though it remains less varied and lower contrast than the reference.
A large dark teal stove dominates the left foreground, with a detailed control panel and adjacent cabinet.
The simplified teal stove and neighboring cabinet occupy the left foreground from a more centered viewpoint.
A dark doorway, narrow angled door edge and plant are visible at the back.
A broad white door leaf, narrow gray opening and plant occupy the rear wall.

uncertainty: The judgment is based on the supplied RGB images; subtle low-contrast texture differences are sensitive to display and lighting. The apparent countertop improvement is partial, and images cannot establish mesh contact, collision, hidden geometry, or long-term capability.
